timerWizardAccHint: Pick a game account, then a character.
timerWizardTaskHint: Pick a task type; add a sub-item if available (e.g. Shield, Spear).
timerWizardTimeHint: Tap quick-add buttons below, or enter days / hours / minutes / seconds.
timerWizardDoneHint: Review the summary, then tap Finish to start the countdown.
timerWizardNeedChar: This account has no characters. Add one under Account management on the left.
timerWizardNeedTime: Please set a duration greater than 0.
sectionFinishedClearTitle: Clear all finished timers for this account
sectionFinishedClearTitleAll: Clear finished timers for all accounts
notifyOnFinishHint: Notify when this timer reaches zero
neonGlowHint: Shown only in dark / auto-dark mode
timerDisplayHint: Clean: plain table (one row per timer). Colorful: cards. List: grouped by character.
confirmSaveDefaultTags:
Save current task tags as the default?

Restore default tags will revert to this state.
alertDefaultTagsSaved: Current tags saved as default. You can restore them anytime.
langGateSub: Choose your language · 選擇語言 · 选择语言
addTimerHintBody: Tap the silver New timer button above. Need help? Try a guide below.
tutorialLoadFailed: Could not load the guide. Open the site via a web server (e.g. python3 -m http.server), not as a local file.
onboardWelcomeBody: We'll walk you through: accounts & characters → task tags → start a timer → undo at the bottom-right.
onboardLayoutBodyDesktop: On desktop, the left panel manages accounts, tags, and new timers; the main area shows countdowns.
onboardLayoutBodyMobile: On mobile, tap Settings at the top to open the side panel.
onboardAddAccountBody: Enter an account name and tap Add. You can also keep the default account and edit later.
onboardAddCharBody: Under an account card, tap + and enter a character name. One account can have many characters.
onboardTaskTagsBody: Built-in tags (Training, Gathering, etc.) are ready to use. To customize, type a name and tap Add.
onboardAddSubBody: Tap a tag card to expand, then add sub-items (e.g. "Shield"). You can start without sub-items.
onboardOpenStartBodyDesktop: Tap New timer on the left to open the start form.
onboardOpenStartBodyMobile: Tap New timer at the top to open the start sheet.
onboardPickRoleBody: Choose the account and character you created (or keep defaults).
onboardPickTaskBody: Choose a task tag; if it has sub-items, a Sub-item dropdown appears.
onboardSetTimeBody: Enter days/hours/minutes/seconds, or tap a shortcut (try +1m first).
onboardStartBody: Tap Start timer — a countdown card appears on the main screen.
onboardDeleteTimerBody: Tap × on the timer card to close this practice timer (you can undo after).
onboardUndoBody: After deleting, tap ↩ Undo to restore the timer. Handy if you remove one by mistake!
onboardDoneBody: You know accounts, tags, timers, and undo. Replay anytime under System & theme.
onboardNeedOpenStartDesktop: Open New timer on the left first.
onboardNeedUndoHint: After deleting, the undo toast appears at the bottom-right.
notifyInstallHint: If the app is missing in Settings → Notifications: open in Safari → Share → Add to Home Screen → open from the icon (not a Safari tab).
notifyInstallOk: Opened from Home Screen. Tap Allow notifications below so the app appears in iPhone Settings → Notifications.
notifyMustAllowFirst: Important: tap Allow notifications in the app first. After iOS prompts you, the app will appear in Settings → Notifications.
notifySearchNames: Settings may show "Game Timer", "Timer", or the site name — scroll the notification list.
notifyNeedStandalone: Not opened from Home Screen (URL bar visible = still in Safari). Remove the old icon, add to Home Screen again, and open only from the icon.
notifyReinstallHint: If Add to Home Screen still fails: delete the icon → add again in Safari → open from new icon → Allow notifications.
notifyIosOld: Web app notifications need iOS 16.4+. Check Settings → General → Software Update.
notifyBannerBody: Tap the button below and choose Allow in the system dialog.
notifyTestBody: If you see this, notifications are working.
notifySafariOnly: Use Safari to Add to Home Screen (Chrome on iPhone usually won't appear in notification settings).
notifyLimitHint: Alerts while the app is open. For push when closed: sign in to cloud, allow notifications, and server push must be configured.
pushBackgroundOk: Background push: scheduled (works when app is closed)
pushBackgroundNeedLogin: Background push: sign in to cloud first
notifyDeniedHint: If you chose Don't Allow, go to iPhone Settings → Notifications → Game Timer.
recoveryNoSnapshots: Backups are created when you add timers; none yet.
recoveryRetentionHint: Up to {max} local snapshots (on each new timer, not by day). Cloud keeps only the latest sync — use Export for older history.
